description: Main entry point for a React-based web application, setting up themes, dynamic imports for development-only debugging, and configuring React Router v7 with future flags. It initializes the root React component and renders it into the DOM.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets the application theme, invoked with 'dark' to apply dark mode globally.

methods.name: createBrowserRouter
methods.description: Creates a React Router browser-based router with route configuration and future flags.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Initializes React rendering root in the specified DOM element.

methods.name: React.StrictMode
methods.description: A React component that activates additional checks and warnings for its descendants in development mode.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React context provider managing authentication state.

methods.name: RouterProvider
methods.description: Provides the configured router to the React component tree.
